description: This file defines an AuthorizationException class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the authorization exception namespace. It extends PHP's base Exception class and provides static methods to create exception instances with specific messages related to support and implementation status of entities and methods.

classes.name: AuthorizationException
classes.description: A custom exception class for authorization-related errors within the OrangeHRM system, providing specific static methods to generate exceptions with informative messages.

methods.name: entityNotSupported
methods.description: Creates an AuthorizationException indicating that a specific entity type is not supported, given the method name.

methods.name: entityNotImplemented
methods.description: Creates an AuthorizationException indicating that a specific entity type is not implemented for a given method.

methods.name: methodNotImplemented
methods.description: Creates an AuthorizationException indicating that a specific method is not implemented.
